scope: Sequential exposed-development diagnostic. E5 final scores have not been read; model full/native was selected in the pre-E5-result design, never by best arm.
question: On this fixed binary source-label task, how does the frozen-LLM system compare with one small nonlinear spatial head using the same EO tokens, source question information, and example exposure budget?

reference.gate: Reference status completed, score valid, independent CPU tensor audit consistent=true, exact audited file hashes unchanged. No E6 training before this gate.

population.membership: Exactly E5 prepared item bytes, order, pairs, batches and evaluation supports. No new selection, repooling, exclusion, relabeling or date correction.

inputs.metadata: One-hot phenomenon (flood,landslide) plus each ordered ISO date encoded as (year-2000)/100,(month-1)/11,(day-1)/30. Same source question information, different encoding from natural language.
inputs.excluded: IDs,tile,coordinates,event,cluster,kind,slots,quality,label,cache path,C1 membership are never model inputs; answer only in training BCE target.
inputs.dates: Retain E5 imputed dates and EO cache bytes despite T0 discovery; source-date repair would require a separate experiment, including encoder timestamps.

architecture.name: SpatialPairHead
architecture.token_projection: LN768 eps1e-5 -> Linear768,128 bias -> GELU exact -> LN128 eps1e-5
architecture.positions: Fixed row-major8x8 sin/cos; each axis64 entries interleaved sin,cos with coordinate/10000^(k/32),k0..31; repeated identically A/B/D; Python float64 sin/cos once rounded float32.
architecture.cls: Learned zero-initialized128-vector plus Linear8,128(metadata); one CLS +192 EO tokens.
architecture.attention: Two independently constructed pre-LN blocks, explicit QKV matmul/softmax noncausal, four32dim heads, residual attention and FFN with exactGELU, allbias=True,eps1e-5.
architecture.output: CLS final LN128 -> Linear128,1; sigmoid probability; yes iff logit>=0.
architecture.initialization: CPU scoped torch seed1/2/3, default Linear/LN initialization in exact source declaration order, typeN(.02),CLSzero. Create/save all3 initial states before any real training and reload each exact state. Matching seed does not match a different architecture initial representation.

training.loss: BCEWithLogitsLoss batch mean, yes=1/no=0; no class weighting
training.precision: float32 throughout, no autocast, TF32 off, deterministic algorithms enabled; CUDA CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8; cuDNNbenchmark=False.
training.order: Reuse exact E5 stored batches for each seed; verify sequential3 default_rng(seed).permutation(4234), batches8 final2. No other updates.
training.selection: Final epoch only. No LR/architecture/seed/threshold sweep, early stopping, augmentation, warmup, class rebalance, retry or resume.
training.log: Every optimizer step batch IDs, epoch/index, loss, finite checks, update/exposure counters; init/final CPU canonical tensor and file hashes; runtime and peak memory.

evaluation.protocol: All1755test once under final head for each3seed; no parameter updates during inference; preserve full precision logits/probability and source metadata.

primary_analysis.contrast: E5 full/native source BA minus E6 full_head/native source BA, separately for each seed.
primary_analysis.population: Frozen C1 902supported quality-symmetric items; same(event,dates,slots) positive/hard-negative strata, 8events.
primary_analysis.aggregation: Recall/specificity balanced within stratum, equal strata within event, equal events. E5 unparsed responses remain incorrect.
primary_analysis.report: Continuous BA, signed delta, paired event95CI and all8event values for all3seeds. No new success cutoff, no seed-averaged primary interval, no best arm selection.
primary_analysis.interpretation: Interval location is descriptive uncertainty on exposed development events. It is not an automatic CVPR claim, equivalence test, or proof of LLM necessity.

secondary_descriptive.paired_flood: 914 pos/pre-pre negative items,10events, same event BA
secondary_descriptive.landslide: 384items,2regions; individual region and macro BA; no bootstrap generalization claim

validity.coverage: Exactly3completedmodels1590updates12702exposures each;5265unique expected headrows and5265referencefull/native rows; exact original membership/gold.
validity.finite: Inputs,A/B/D,metadata,model/init/final tensors,loss,all trainable gradients,logits/probability finite; sigmoid(logit) consistency and prediction threshold.
validity.provenance: E5 audit before prepare; input/source/plan/init snapshots before training, actual frozen snapshot executes; hash rechecks after run.
validity.failure: Stop and retain partial files as execution-invalid; no silent rerun,resume,seed replacement,exclusions or budget changes.

compute.launch: Only idle authorized GPU0, same cooperative inherited lock/UUID/manifest checks; no foreign interruption; E5 must finish and independently validate first.
compute.timing: Record this run walltime/train/eval/peak memory only. No direct latency ratio against historical E5 timings without matched resident-model timing protocol.

limitations: Same source inputs and example exposure do not equalize FLOPs, model size, linguistic pretraining, optimization difficulty or losses.
This is a two-system comparison; replacing the LLM also changes architecture, metadata representation, objective and output parsing.
The EO features already contain date metadata; this is not visual-only even without the explicit date vector.
Source flood labels/post masks and pre/pre absence assumptions do not establish physically verified change onset; T0 does not repair these labels.
Only8exposed development events; sensors confounded with phenomena; landslide region imbalance remains.
Head parity would challenge the need for an LLM for this fixed binary task, not for open-ended grounded EO questions. Head underperformance alone would not prove LLM necessity.
No memory-system, causal impact, current damage, fresh generalization or paper acceptance claim from this experiment alone.
